design_concept: The New Yorker inspired editorial wedding website. Cultivated, visual restraint, observational humor. Collectible illustrated cover feel.

fonts.role: Labels, Times, Captions, Metadata, Nav (Restrained Sans)

rules: Use tracking-tight for large headlines (Cormorant Garamond).
Use tracking-[0.2em] uppercase for overlines, metadata, and timestamps (Chivo).
Never use Inter or generic sans for any text.
Dramatic scale selectively: names at text-5xl or text-6xl, small functional info at text-xs or text-sm.
Use drop caps for the first letter of story sections.
No pure white (#FFFFFF). Page base is warm ivory (#F7F5F0).
Text is deep charcoal (#1A1A1A), not pure black.
Use oxblood red for primary actions (RSVP button) and key editorial highlights.
Shift to darker tones (charcoal/dark green) specifically for the 'After-Party' section of the schedule.

stamps: Couple's Seal: 'SK+KS' center, 'PROPERTY OF' upper arc, 'NYC' lower arc.
Use absolute positioning to place these slightly offset/rotated on the edges of sections (max 1-2 per screen). Color: Oxblood or Charcoal.
editorial_details: Use fine 1px solid lines (border-b or border-t border-charcoal/20) to separate sections, not standard floating cards.
Use folio-style page numbers and running labels in the margins.
Apply a subtle noise/grain texture overlay (opacity: 0.03, pointer-events-none, mix-blend-multiply) across the entire app wrapper to simulate paper.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-16, py-24. Wide margins.
layouts.grid_system: Asymmetric editorial grid. Use a 12-column grid where text may span col-4 to col-10, leaving empty columns for margin notes or stamps.

sections.homepage_cover: Full height (min-h-screen). Central bespoke illustration, prominent RSVP, names, date. No scroll hijacking.
sections.schedule: Narrow editorial column, times on the left (Chivo text-xs tracking-widest), event names on the right (Cormorant Garamond text-2xl).
sections.our_story: Magazine feature layout. Large pull quotes, asymmetrical image placement.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Solid oxblood or charcoal background, ivory text. No shadows. Subtle hover state (opacity 90% or scale 0.98).
components.rsvp_form: Customize Shadcn inputs to look like a printed form: transparent backgrounds, border-b-2 border-[#1A1A1A]/20 only, no rounded corners. Label floating or tightly above.
components.accordion: FAQ uses Shadcn accordion but styled with fine rules (1px top/bottom borders), Cormorant Garamond for questions, Chivo for answers.
components.navigation: Sticky top bar, solid ivory background (NO transparent backgrounds to avoid text overlap). SK+KS seal on left, desktop links centered or right.

motion.philosophy: Editorial, controlled, nearly effortless. Respect reduced-motion.
animations: Hero reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for names.
Stamps: Arrive as finishing details (gentle scale down from 1.2 and fade in).
Scroll: Soft fades (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0) for sections as they enter viewport.
Hover: Gentle underlines expanding from left to right.

hero_illustration.description: Watercolor landscape. Use as placeholder for 'bespoke ink-and-wash illustration of couple crossing Central Park South'.

our_story_portrait.description: Black and white portrait of a couple posing. Use in 'Our Story' section.

new_york_guide.description: Flatiron building. Use as a header or divider image for the 'New York Guide' section.

evening_schedule.description: Classic NY fire escape architecture (B&W). Use as spot illustration or transitional image.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered text alignment globally (.App { text-align: center }). Text should flow naturally, largely left-aligned, with center alignment used strictly for decorative editorial intent.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
Use 'lucide-react' for basic icons but rely more on typography and CSS shapes (like circles for stamps) than generic icons. Avoid emoji.
Do NOT use HTML native date/select. Use Shadcn components for forms, but strip their default Vercel-like styling completely to match the print/editorial vibe.
Ensure 'sonner' toast notifications match the ivory/charcoal styling with Serif fonts.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; it must be solid ivory (#F7F5F0) to ensure readability.
Implement the UI using React (.js files, NOT .tsx) + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion. Shadcn primitives go into src/components/ui/.
For the custom 'Stamps', use absolute positioning in relative containers so they overlap content slightly like a real inked stamp.
